config.connectionString: SQL Server connection string used when the launch configuration has none. Leave empty to be asked at start (the answer can be stored securely in SecretStorage).
config.moduleFiles: What F5 does on a file that defines a procedure/function: ask, debug the body with parameters, or run the script as is.
launch.program: Path to the .sql file to debug.
launch.mode: invoke = run the script, module = debug the body of the file's CREATE FUNCTION/PROCEDURE with parameter values, attach = wait for marked traffic (requires a license for remote).
launch.params: Parameter values in module mode (name -> value, null for NULL). Missing parameters are asked for at start.
launch.stopOnEntry: Stop on the first statement even without breakpoints.
launch.transaction: Run the script inside a transaction: rollback = undo all changes when the session ends (dry run), commit = commit at the end, none = autocommit as usual.
launch.debugDatabase: Database where the __dbg debug schema is created (default: the connection's database). Use when you lack DDL rights in the target database.
launch.sidecarUrl: URL of a sidecar. Normally omitted: each VS Code window then starts its own sidecar on a random port. Set only if you run the sidecar yourself (e.g. http://localhost:5199).
launch.sidecarToken: Bearer token for a self-started sidecar (its SQLDBGR_TOKEN). Omit for the automatically started sidecar.
launch.autoStartSidecar: Start a sidecar automatically (bundled with the extension). Set false to only use sidecarUrl.
launch.sidecarCommand: Command that starts the sidecar; --port is appended automatically. Default: the bundled sidecar. During development: ["dotnet", "run", "--project", "${workspaceFolder}/sidecar", "--"].

config.attachExtension: Extension id of the separate, licensed attach provider (see docs/ATTACH-PROTOCOL.md).
attach.program: File or virtual document breakpoints are mapped against. Usually chosen by the attach provider.
